components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a task flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #A33A2E; color: #FFF9F1; font: 600 13px/17px InterTight, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1px; transition: opacity 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out, outline-color 120ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: .92; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(163, 58, 46, .28); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bounded but quiet alternative or back action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 14px 20px; border: 1px solid #DED6C9; border-radius: 999px; background: #FCFAF5; color: #211F1B; font: 600 13px/17px InterTight, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1px; transition: background 120ms ease-out, border-color 120ms ease-out, transform 120ms ease-out; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #ECE6DB; border-color: #C7BDAE; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(163, 58, 46, .24); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.description: The primary food lookup field with a visible rust focus state.
components.html: <label class="ds-search"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"></circle><path d="m20 20-4-4"></path></svg><input type="search" placeholder="Search foods or brands" aria-label="Search foods or brands"></label>
components.css: .ds-search { min-height: 50px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 18px; border: 1px solid #DED6C9; border-radius: 14px; background: #FCFAF5; color: #625C54; transition: border-color 120ms ease-out, box-shadow 120ms ease-out; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: #A33A2E; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(163, 58, 46, .10); color: #A33A2E; } .ds-search svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; } .ds-search input { min-width: 0; flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: #211F1B; font: 400 16px/23px InterTight, sans-serif; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: #70695F; }

narrative.overview:
The Calibrated Field Journal treats nutrition tracking like a well-kept working notebook: warm paper, measured serif observations, compact utility labels, and rust annotations that call attention without shouting. The interface is tactile but not nostalgic; every material cue supports faster logging, clearer targets, or more trustworthy review.

Warm editorial discipline governs the balance. Data-rich surfaces remain calm through narrow content columns, generous breathing room, and hairline structure. Rounded cards are reserved for self-contained tools and summaries, while account and statistics views often become ruled ledgers. The result is humane enough for a first-time calorie counter and precise enough for a macro-focused athlete.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and deep ink carry the interface before accent color enters.
Rust is scarce, intentional, and tied to action, selection, or meaningful progress.
Instrument Serif creates reflective display moments; Inter Tight does the work; JetBrains Mono supplies coordinates and status.
Cards and ruled sections coexist according to function instead of forcing every region into one container style.
Motion is brief, physical, and subordinate to state clarity, with reduced-motion behavior preserved wherever the shared motion layer is used.

rules.name: The Rust Annotation Rule
rules.body: Rust marks the primary decision, selected state, or consequential progress moment; it never floods the screen.

rules.name: The Ink Before Color Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy begins with ink weight, paper tone, and rules. Add color only when it carries state or meaning.

rules.name: The Three Registers Rule
rules.body: Instrument Serif carries reflection and magnitude, Inter Tight carries work, and JetBrains Mono carries coordinates and status; do not swap their jobs casually.

rules.name: The One Honest Column Rule
rules.body: Primary task flows stay in one centered column; wide screens add breathing room or a specific second pane, not a stretched phone layout.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Resting content is separated by tone, borders, and rules. Shadows appear only when an element truly floats, overlays, or moves.

rules.name: The Shape Follows Task Rule
rules.body: Use medium curves for fields and working controls, generous curves for summary objects, and pills only for compact actions, selections, and progress.

rules.name: The State Reads Twice Rule
rules.body: Interactive state must be communicated through at least two of color, fill, border, icon, label, or motion, never color alone.

dos: Do let warm paper and Carbon Ink establish hierarchy before introducing accent color.
Do use Rust Marker sparingly for the primary decision, active selection, focus, or meaningful progress.
Do choose between a rounded working card and a ruled ledger section according to the information's function.
Do preserve the editorial type registers and constrain explanatory copy to readable line lengths.
Do support light and dark Paper appearances, font scaling, reduced motion, safe areas, and explicit accessibility state.
Do use native segmented controls, pickers, sheets, and system navigation behavior where the platform already provides the correct interaction.
donts: Don't turn kiloric into neon gamified fitness UI with saturated gradients, glowing rings, aggressive achievement chrome, or synthetic hype.
Don't flood screens with rust or make every interactive accent the brand color; Carbon Ink and semantic colors have distinct jobs.
Don't place every section in a rounded card or add shadows to resting content merely to create hierarchy.
Don't stretch mobile content edge to edge on wide web layouts or leave a phone bottom bar unchanged on expanded native layouts.
Don't treat missing nutrition data as zero or use visual completion to imply evidence the product does not have.
Don't normalize the scoped onboarding palette, legacy themes, or known one-off controls into the Paper baseline.
Don't use Instrument Serif for dense controls, long body copy, or technical metadata.
